requirements.title: Customer can create an order and initiate payment for the order total
requirements.description: A customer must be able to create an order and initiate payment for the order total.

requirements.title: System must integrate with Stripe as the payment provider for card payments
requirements.description: The system must integrate with Stripe as the payment provider for card payments.

requirements.title: System must create a payment record in a 'pending' state before redirecting the customer to the payment provider
requirements.description: The system must create a payment record in a 'pending' state before redirecting the customer to the payment provider.

requirements.title: System must expose a webhook endpoint to receive asynchronous payment status callbacks from Stripe
requirements.description: The system must expose a webhook endpoint to receive asynchronous payment status callbacks from Stripe.

requirements.title: Incoming webhook callbacks must be verified using the provider's signature scheme before being trusted
requirements.description: Incoming webhook callbacks must be verified using the provider's signature scheme before being trusted.

requirements.title: System must handle out-of-order or duplicate webhook deliveries without double-crediting an order (idempotency)
requirements.description: The system must handle out-of-order or duplicate webhook deliveries without double-crediting an order (idempotency).

requirements.title: If a payment fails, the order must be marked 'payment failed' and the customer must be able to retry payment with the same order
requirements.description: If a payment fails, the order must be marked 'payment failed' and the customer must be able to retry payment with the same order.

requirements.title: The system must record the provider's failure reason code for every failed payment attempt
requirements.description: The system must record the provider's failure reason code for every failed payment attempt.

requirements.title: A Support Agent must be able to issue a full or partial refund for a completed payment
requirements.description: A Support Agent must be able to issue a full or partial refund for a completed payment.

requirements.title: A refund must not exceed the original captured payment amount
requirements.description: A refund must not exceed the original captured payment amount.

requirements.title: The customer must be notified by email when a refund is issued
requirements.description: The customer must be notified by email when a refund is issued.

requirements.title: Every payment state transition must be recorded in an immutable audit log with a timestamp and the actor that caused it
requirements.description: Every payment state transition (pending, authorized, captured, failed, refunded) must be recorded in an immutable audit log with a timestamp and the actor (customer, webhook, support agent) that caused it.

requirements.title: Payment webhook processing must complete within 2 seconds under normal load
requirements.description: Payment webhook processing must complete within 2 seconds under normal load.

requirements.title: The payment audit log must be retained for 7 years for financial compliance purposes
requirements.description: The payment audit log must be retained for 7 years for financial compliance purposes.

requirements.title: The system must be resilient to the payment provider being temporarily unreachable — orders must not be lost if Stripe's API times out during order creation
requirements.description: The system must be resilient to the payment provider being temporarily unreachable — orders must not be lost if Stripe's API times out during order creation.

requirements.title: Only Stripe is in scope for this release; no other payment providers are required
requirements.description: Only Stripe is in scope for this release; no other payment providers are required.

requirements.title: The system must not store raw card numbers (PCI-DSS scope reduction via Stripe-hosted card entry)
requirements.description: The system must not store raw card numbers (PCI-DSS scope reduction via Stripe-hosted card entry).

requirements.title: Payment processing depends on the order-creation flow being completed first
requirements.description: Payment processing depends on the order-creation flow being completed first.

requirements.title: Refunds depend on a payment already being in a 'captured' state
requirements.description: Refunds depend on a payment already being in a 'captured' state.

requirements.title: Webhook signature verification depends on a shared secret configured with Stripe at deployment time
requirements.description: Webhook signature verification depends on a shared secret configured with Stripe at deployment time.

requirements.title: Duplicate webhook delivery could cause double-fulfillment if idempotency is not correctly implemented
requirements.description: Duplicate webhook delivery could cause double-fulfillment if idempotency is not correctly implemented.

requirements.title: What is the definition of 'normal load' in the context of webhook processing time?
requirements.description: The requirement states that webhook processing must complete within 2 seconds under normal load. What constitutes 'normal load' in terms of concurrent requests, traffic volume, or system performance metrics?

requirements.title: What is the exact format or schema of the payment failure reason code that must be recorded?
requirements.description: The system must record the provider's failure reason code for every failed payment attempt. What is the specific format or schema (e.g., Stripe error code) that must be captured and stored?

requirements.title: What is the definition of 'completed payment' in the context of refund eligibility?
requirements.description: Refunds depend on a payment being in a 'captured' state. What is the precise definition of a 'completed payment' or 'captured' state, and how is it determined by the system?

requirements.title: What is the mechanism for notifying the customer via email when a refund is issued?
requirements.description: The customer must be notified by email when a refund is issued. What is the email delivery mechanism (e.g., SMTP, email service), and is there a requirement for delivery confirmation or failure handling?

requirements.title: What is the actor scope for audit log entries — is it limited to customer, webhook, or support agent?
requirements.description: Every payment state transition must be recorded with the actor that caused it. What are the specific actors (e.g., customer, webhook, support agent) that are allowed to trigger audit log entries?

requirements.title: The system will be deployed with a shared secret pre-configured with Stripe at runtime
requirements.description: It is assumed that a shared secret will be configured at deployment time for webhook signature verification, as referenced in the dependency section.

requirements.title: The order-creation flow will be completed before any payment processing begins
requirements.description: It is assumed that the order-creation flow will be completed before any payment processing begins, as stated in the dependency section.

requirements.title: The payment audit log will be stored in a secure, immutable database with full access controls
requirements.description: It is assumed that the audit log will be stored in a secure, immutable database with full access controls to meet compliance and data integrity requirements.

requirements.title: Implement a health check endpoint to monitor Stripe API connectivity and alert on outages
requirements.description: To improve system resilience, consider implementing a health check endpoint that monitors Stripe API connectivity and triggers alerts during outages.

requirements.title: Add logging and monitoring for webhook delivery patterns to detect duplicates or out-of-order events
requirements.description: To support idempotency and detect duplicate deliveries, recommend adding logging and monitoring for webhook delivery patterns (e.g., timestamps, delivery sequence).

clarifications.question: What is the definition of 'normal load' in the context of webhook processing time? For example, what is the expected number of concurrent requests or the system's CPU/memory utilization under normal load?
clarifications.reason_for_asking: The requirement states that webhook processing must complete within 2 seconds under normal load, but 'normal load' is not defined, making it non-testable and ambiguous.

clarifications.question: What is the specific format or schema (e.g., Stripe error code) of the payment failure reason code that must be recorded for failed payments?
clarifications.reason_for_asking: The requirement states that the failure reason code must be recorded, but no schema or format is specified, making it non-testable.

clarifications.question: What is the precise definition of a 'completed payment' or 'captured' state, and how is it determined by the system?
clarifications.reason_for_asking: The requirement states that refunds depend on a payment being in a 'captured' state, but no definition of 'captured' is provided, making it ambiguous.

clarifications.question: What is the mechanism for notifying the customer via email when a refund is issued? Is there a requirement for delivery confirmation or failure handling?
clarifications.reason_for_asking: The requirement states that the customer must be notified by email, but no mechanism or error handling is specified.

clarifications.question: What are the specific actors (e.g., customer, webhook, support agent) that are allowed to trigger audit log entries?
clarifications.reason_for_asking: The requirement states that audit log entries must include the actor that caused the state transition, but the scope of allowed actors is not defined.
